name: JAL USA Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs based on the Prime Rate (6.75% as of the 08/31/2026 determination date). Purchase and balance transfer APR is Prime plus 16.74%; cash advance APR is Prime plus 21.99%. No penalty APR. Balance transfer fee is $10 or 5%, cash advance fee is $5 or 5%, whichever is greater. Late fee up to $40. Minimum interest charge $1.75.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is None per the Summary of Credit Terms.

credit_required.notes: Applicants must be JAL Mileage Bank members, 18 or older, with a U.S. address.

base_rate.description: Basic Rewards: earn 1 point for each $2.00 spent on Net Purchases; each point equals 1 JMB Airmile.

rewards.redemption_notes: Each Point earned in the Credit Card Rewards Program will equate to 1 JMB Airmile, which will be redeemable only through the JMB Program.

notes: Issued by First National Bank of Omaha (FNBO) under a license from Mastercard. The Summary of Credit Terms says approved applicants may receive a Platinum Edition Mastercard or a World Mastercard, so network_tier is none. Recorded values are the Basic Rewards option with a $35 annual fee. The optional Premium Rewards option adds a $50 annual Credit Card Rewards Program fee and earns 2 points per $1 on JAL Purchases (JAL flight tickets bought directly from JAL) and 1 point per $1 on other Net Purchases. A separate set of credit terms for campaign-code applications shows no annual fee for the first year, then $35.
